_doc: Standards-aware dimensions + adaptable CSG recipe templates for the planner. The planner RETRIEVES these (lookup_design_reference) and INLINES adapted steps into its PrimitivePlan. Recipes use ONLY real library primitives + operations (base/union/cut/finish-NONE) + pattern, so the emitted plan needs no compile/schema change. Source for fastener dims: CadQuery KB (rag_kb1) / ISO metric clearance + counterbore.
_origin_convention: CRITICAL: box/cylinder/sphere/capsule/ellipsoid/*_box/rounded_cylinder are CENTERED at `position` in every axis. A cut/union cylinder of height H placed at position.z = Z spans Z-H/2 .. Z+H/2. To pierce a body that spans z=0..T, place a cut cylinder at position.z = T/2 with height = T+1 (spans -0.5..T+0.5). ring/profile_extrude/revolve instead extrude UP from position.z (base at position). All recipe placeholders below already follow this.

fastener_dims._doc: Millimetres. clearance = through-hole diameter for a bolt; tap = pilot for threading; cbore_d/cbore_h = counterbore diameter/depth for a socket-head cap screw.

through_hole.description: A bolt clearance hole cut straight through a body spanning z=0..T at (x,y). radius = clearance[size]/2. Cut cylinder is CENTERED, so position.z = T/2, height = T+1 (pierces fully).

counterbored_hole.description: Socket-head cap-screw pocket in a body spanning z=0..T: a clearance hole all the way through, plus a wider counterbore recessed from the TOP face. Both cuts CENTERED.

bolt_circle.description: N clearance holes evenly spaced on a circle of radius R about Z, through a body z=0..T. ONE patterned cut step — do NOT emit N separate steps. Cut cylinder CENTERED → position.z = T/2.

corner_holes.description: Clearance holes inset `m` from the corners of a W×D plate spanning z=0..T. Emit one cut per corner (unique ids) at (±(W/2-m), ±(D/2-m)). Cut cylinder CENTERED → position.z = T/2.
corner_holes.note: Repeat at the other three corners (swap signs of x and y), unique ids: corner_ne, corner_sw, corner_se.

rib.description: A stiffening rib = a thin tall box unioned onto the body along a span. Box is CENTERED, so to sit a rib of height h_rib on a body z=0..T set position.z = h_rib/2 (rib base on the plane) and OVERLAP the bodies it joins by ~1mm at each end.

mounting_plate.description: A flat base plate with four corner mounting holes. Compose: base box (CENTERED → position.z = T/2 to rest on plane), then the corner_holes recipe.
mounting_plate.note: Then inline the corner_holes recipe (size, m) for the fastening holes.

open_vessel_cup.description: ONE-STEP open vessel (cup/bottle body). Single-part platform: NO separate cap. hollow_cylinder extrudes UP from position z=0.
open_vessel_cup.note: Cap/lid assemblies are OUT OF SCOPE. Optional: add a finish fillet only. Prefer this over cylinder+cut+union cap.

open_vessel_bottle_revolve.description: ONE-STEP contoured bottle as revolve of a walled 2D profile (outer wall up, rim, inner wall down, floor). Single solid, open top.
open_vessel_bottle_revolve.note: Profile points are [x,y] with x>=0, revolve about Y. Do NOT add a cap union.
